candidates.title: Calibrate, Then Route: A Measured Study of Learned Request Routing for Disaggregated LLM Serving
candidates.reason: prefill/decode分離でprompt length、予測output length、admission後KV圧力、SLO classを使うrouting cost modelを実機8×A40/vLLM/NIXLで校正。calibration誤差がgoodputとtail latency利得を大きく削ること、資源不足時にはgreedy routingが逆効果になる境界まで測っており、実運用routing policyの有用なnegative/positive条件を示す最新研究。
